name: Koi to Mizugi to Taiyou to ~Sumire-jima Life Savers~
original_name: 恋と水着と太陽と　～スミレ島ライフセーバーず～
source:
Eiji, a member of his school's swimming club, attends a high school on the mainland separated from his parents and family. For the summer the club decides to visit Sumire Island, Eiji's home town, for a mixture of training camp and vacation. Eiji is glad to see his mother again and meets lots of old friends and acquaintances.

However, in recent years Sumire Island has become a hot spot for summer tourists and is overcrowded, so the group has trouble finding a place to stay. Luckily, they all can stay at Eiji's place and even decide to start working as life guards, helping to protect the crowded beaches.

Eiji's exciting summer can now begin.

[From Erogeshop]
translation:
英司是学校游泳社成员，离开父母与家人，在本土的一所高中就读。暑假期间，社团决定前往英司的故乡堇岛，把集训与度假结合起来。英司很高兴能再次见到母亲，也遇到了许多老朋友和熟人。

然而，近年来堇岛已经成为夏季旅游胜地，岛上人满为患，一行人很难找到住处。幸运的是，所有人都能住进英司家，还决定担任救生员，协助守护拥挤的海滩。

英司精彩纷呈的夏天就此开始。

[摘自Erogeshop]
